text.content:
It runs the city's infrastructure. Nobody knows much else.

Headquarters: Its global HQ is in Downtown Night City
Industry: Infrastructure, construction, transit (it bought NCART in 2068)
Leadership: Founded by Miriam Night, Richard Night's widow
In Night City: Everywhere and almost invisible

After Richard Night was murdered, his widow Miriam turned his foundation into a corporation able to stand among the megacorps. Night Corp brought the nomads in to rebuild after the 4th Corporate War and talked the city's quarreling factions into forming a new government.

It keeps its structure, goals and resources secret, and its own employees know only what their jobs require, which makes it a favorite of conspiracy theorists.

Gig hooks

  • Someone wants blueprints of a Night Corp substation. The substation isn't on any city map.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.24
